_note: Other names of Claude models, each mapped to Anthropic's API model id, so the cost report and the finish card and progress comment (usage.mjs modelName) name each model once. GitHub Copilot's model catalog writes a Claude model's version with a dot (`claude-sonnet-5.5`), Anthropic's API with a hyphen (`claude-sonnet-5-5`). Only the ids listed here are renamed: any other id stays as recorded, so an API id that has a dot in its own right (`claude-2.1`) is never touched.
